title: Weil structures on regular tame eigensheaves
exact_target: Let $n>=2,p>n,\ell $ different from p, and let X/Fq be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two with a rational marked point x. For an arithmetic PGLn parameter on X minus x over a finite extension of $Q_\ell $ whose geometric image is Zariski dense and whose inertia at x is wild-trivial regular-unipotent tame $\exp (t_\ell $ N), must some finite constant-field extension support a nonzero Weil sheaf on SLn-bundles with Borel reduction at x, geometrically locally constructible perverse with nilpotent singular support, and coherent all-leg Hecke eigenisomorphisms as Weil sheaves?
